pcs.pc_description: obtain feed from safe sources and analyse for risks
verify that the feed meets requirements in order to protect poultry against foodborne hazards
maintain feed in a stable condition so as to protect feed from contamination during production, handling, storage and transport
check that the labelling of feed is consistent with statutory requirements

store feed in a good condition as per the accepted quality standards
monitor feed on a regular basis by sampling and analysis of undesirable substances
ensure proper segregation of waste into different categories
ensure safety of feed from consumption of rhodents by adopting rhodent control programmes

modules.module_title: Ensure general food safety practices are in place

pcs.pc_description: ensure effective food safety processes and programs are in place
ensure compliance with food standards code and other food safety requirement
monitor staff closely on compliance to food safety rules and regulations
ensure proper hygiene and sanitation of equipment, surfaces and environment during slaughter, fabrication and further processing of poultry and poultry products
ensure sound husbandary practices in growing, collecting, transporting and handling birds
ensure compliance with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP)
follow GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and HACCP principles to control hazards that may affect food safety

modules.module_title: Comply with food safety checklist related to production of eggs and meat

pcs.pc_description: ensure the egg shells are cleaned using a dry cleaning method
ensure eggs with abnormal shape, spots, cracks or any other irregularities are discarded
ensure proper grading and sizing of the eggs as per the SOPs
carry out egg packaging and labelling in accordance with the industry standards
prevent contamination during the slaughter process for the production of quality meat

modules.module_title: Maintain records of feed and feed ingredients

pcs.pc_description: document procedures and relevant farm practices adopted in the concerned poultry farm to ensure that producers have correctly developed, implemented and updated an effective feed production and management system
maintain records of feed purchased including the ingredient composition
capture details such as date of purchase, quantity of purchase, supplier name, to ease product recall process if any adverse effects on poultry health are identified
document the records of non-conforming food products
maintain record of HACCP plan
maintain records on observations or deviations related to production of food products
verify documents and track from finished products to ingredients, for quality management system audits
maintain detailed records of the finished products, as per organisation's standards
